_comment: This authorizes exactly the stable 0.10.0 pre-1.0 capability release. Preview declarations, including 0.10.0-preview.3, are separate and unchanged.

The required product/release scope is the source-only package (#567), canonical classifier/catalog parity (#568), infrastructure/UI/Unity annotations (#571), adoption guidance (#573), and packed external-consumer release gate (#574).
The candidate also carries the reviewed dependency refresh in PR #1100, including System.CommandLine, Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection, and System.Security.Cryptography.Xml updates.

The annotation contract (#566), layered/DDD annotations (#569), CQRS/messaging/web/API annotations (#570), bounded context metadata (#572), repository metrics badge depth (#1057), audit-only applicability correction (#1061), and read-only diagnostics correctness fix (#1084) are delivered context from prior previews.

PR #1093 corrected preview release metadata after preview.3 and does not add stable product scope. The candidate quality-preparation PR contains CI/Sonar/Qodana verification and targeted single-pass input-validation and process-disposal corrections; it is not an additional capability claim.
Release notes were audited: #1094 and #1101 are Features, #1100 is Dependencies, #1103 is Documentation, and #1093, #1104, and the preparation PR are excluded from generated notes.

Publication requires a maintainer dry run with release_type=minor, version_override=0.10.0, and publish=false after the final cleanup PR is merged and main is green, followed by separate reviewed publication. This declaration does not publish anything.

required_items.summary: Ship the optional source-only ArchLinterNet.Annotations package with no runtime annotation assembly
Recognize canonical annotations through the existing role classifier and preserve catalog parity
Deliver the reviewed infrastructure, UI, and Unity annotation families
Document annotation-first adoption, migration, compatibility, and custom attribute mappings
Prove stable 0.10.0 behavior from packed artifacts in representative external consumers
Include the reviewed runtime and tooling dependency updates already merged into the 0.10.0 candidate

excluded_items.reason: PR #1093 corrected prerelease metadata for the already published preview.3; it changes no stable package behavior and is intentionally excluded from release notes.

delivered_items.reason: The reviewed annotation identity, package, and role-vs-context contract was delivered in an earlier preview.
The layered and DDD annotation family was delivered in an earlier preview.
The CQRS, messaging, and web/API annotation family was delivered in preview.3.
Bounded context metadata composition was delivered in preview.3.
Repository metrics and Structure badge depth are carried-forward preview context.
The audit-only applicability correction was delivered in preview.2.
The read-only diagnostics correctness correction was delivered in preview.3.
